items.title: Akiyoshi Toshiko — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Jun Shimizu, he was the first bebop player, one of those, you know, broken rhythm, he was the first one.

ctx.x: Did they really capture the bebop style?

Bebop style? Probably. I don‟t know. I don‟t remember anything, besides the fact that I was just introduced to it and I couldn‟t tell one way or another, probably [chuckles]. The first bebop players, at that time, there was young musicians, together they were called CB9, for some reason. They were playing in Yokohama. And they were the … Jun Shimizu, he was the first bebop player, one of those, you know, broken rhythm, he was the first one. And, uh, I‟m not quite sure, but I couldn‟t probably tell in those days…
